title: Scout C-B: retrieval, evidence reuse, Jev call sites and decision/promotion plumbing (what exists for P2, P8, P9, P17, P20, P26, P30)
spec: Objective: tell the Planner which retrieval and evidence mechanisms already exist, which agents re-retrieve the same evidence, and what every Jev call sends off the machine. Read (this checkout, main): orchestrator/spawn.py memory_recall (line 11) and .claude/skills/memory/scripts/recall.py (layers, ranking, limits), orchestrator/scout_evidence.py (reuse_check, record_decision, freshness), orchestrator/repomap.py, .claude/skills/memory/scripts/graph.sh and any graphify use, orchestrator/stale.py, orchestrator/jev.py (ask, redact, budget, usage log), orchestrator/jev_gate.py (what tool calls are gated, the state sent, thresholds), orchestrator/jev_route.py, jev_planner.py, jev_sched.py, jev_points.py, jev_rank.py (each call site: state payload, questions, mode), orchestrator/decision_log.py (KINDS, record/outcome, storage), orchestrator/promotion.py (FEATURES table, criteria, evaluate), orchestrator/attribution.py and orchestrator/scorecard.py (which token/cost fields exist per task, role, model; routing_eval). Deliver: 1. every place an agent reads repository evidence (memory recall, repomap, scout, graph, worker Read/Grep) and whether a second agent on the same task repeats it, with anchors; 2. existing reuse/dedup mechanisms (scout_evidence reuse_check, caches) and their keys/freshness rules; 3. a table of Jev call sites: module:line, what state text is sent, redaction applied, questions, mode key, fail-open behaviour (the P20 audit input); 4. decision_log KINDS today versus the P26 list, and where outcome() is called; 5. promotion FEATURES today versus the P30 candidates, and the criteria vocabulary; 6. attribution/scorecard fields available per task and role for P1 (what tokens are already split, what is missing). Rules: read-only; cite path:line; confidence per finding; result under 1,500 tokens; unverifiable stated as such.
acceptance: result under 1,500 tokens with findings anchored path:line and confidence
every deliverable item answered or marked unverifiable

constraints.objective: retrieval evidence jev decision promotion inventory

findings.claim: spawn.py memory_recall (11) is called independently per role-packet build: execute/review packet at spawn.py:276 and scout_packet at spawn.py:537, each re-querying notes+bus layers with title+scope text — no cache shared across a task's scout/execute/review agents, so each repeats the recall
scout_evidence.py:29 reimplements the identical lazy-import pattern as spawn.py:11 (duplicate loader for the same recall.py) rather than reusing spawn.memory_recall
repomap.build() is not part of any agent packet; it's invoked only via `orchestrator repomap` CLI (cli.py:282) and auto-refresh in merge.py:85 after a merge — one-shot, not re-read per agent

graphify graph layer is read by recall.py index_graph and by scout_evidence.reuse_check (layers include graph) but NOT by spawn.py's packet-building recall calls (layers=notes,bus only) — graph evidence only reaches the pre-scout gate, not execute/review packets

reuse_check (scout_evidence.py:74) is the only scout dedup: keys=title+objective via memory_recall(notes,bus,graph); freshness=age<=max_age_days(14) plus bus hits validated by _bus_fresh (scout_evidence.py:53) checking packet_meta.base against moved_paths(head_sha); called once, at mcp.py:85, before a scout spawns
jev_gate.py has a separate session-scoped dedup (block_repeats): input_hash+target mtime keyed per session_id (jev_gate.py:172-199), independent of scout_evidence's cross-task reuse_check

Jev call sites (state/redaction/questions/mode/fail-open): jev_gate.py:221 ask_jev sends task title+spec[:1500]+acceptance+scope+role, 20 redacted recent tool calls, proposed tool redacted input[:300] (needed/redundant/destructive noul); mode=jev.gate_mode; fail-open=allow(0) on None

jev_route.py:classify(97) sends redacted spec[:1500]/acceptance/scope/complexity/task_class/memory_titles[:10]; 7 noul signals (jev_route.py:13); mode=[jev.routing].mode; fail-open=None→neutral 1.0 multipliers

jev_planner.py:ask(126) sends state() (33) redacted subject_id/title/spec_excerpt[:300]/goal_title/scope_count/etc, capped 4000 chars; 5 noul signals; mode=cfg.jev_mode(shadow default); fail-open=raw None→reason jev_unavailable, soft_adjust 0

jev_sched.py:annotate(194) sends redacted pair titles/scope/spec_excerpts[:400]/reasons for up to jev_max_pairs(8) ambiguous pairs; 2 noul questions/pair; mode=scheduler.jev_mode; fail-open=exception→signals={} error set, wave unchanged

jev_points.py:ask(148) sends redacted title[:300]/spec[:600]/scope[:300 each]/complexity/task_class/memory_titles/deterministic_evidence (content/source keys stripped, jev_points.py:91-107); 2 options/point noul; mode=jev.points.<point>(shadow default); fail-open=exception→error set, applied=False

jev_rank.py:rank(41) sends goal_text unredacted by rank itself (caller's responsibility) plus one noul/item batched 40; no mode key (unconditional if jev enabled); fail-open=None/exception→all items unranked p_relevant=None

decision_log.py KINDS today: routing, wave, capacity, concurrency, merge_pressure, stale, jev_sched, allocation, strategy, speculation, scout, review_plan, planner_route (13 kinds); outcome() called at executor.py:313 for kind='allocation'; no other outcome() call sites found in orchestrator/

open_questions: P26/P30 target lists not found in this checkout — may live in an external doc or a later commit not present on main at e8c4687
suggested_next: diff decision_log.KINDS/promotion.FEATURES against the actual P26/P30 spec once located, rather than against memory titles
